_about: Real targets for the event. Terrain values (slope, roughness, relief, linearity) are computed from each target's DEM tile at run time; the profile holds what the DEM cannot give. Entries marked VERIFY are placeholders from memory: replace them before presenting.

shackleton_rim.label: Shackleton crater rim
shackleton_rim.coords_source: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, crater centre (21 km across, 4.2 km deep)
shackleton_rim.dem: LOLA gridded DEM at 64 px/deg for the 463 m scale; NASA ADC 2023 'Peak Near Shackleton' or 'Connecting Ridge' CSVs for zoom-ins
shackleton_rim.profile_source: Temperatures: NASA Moon Base page (54 °C sunlit to −203 °C in shadowed craters). Ground ice 1.0 because the shadowed floor is believed to hold ice.

malapert_massif.label: Malapert Massif
malapert_massif.coords_source: Take the centre from the NASA ADC 2023 'Malapert Massif' latitude and longitude CSVs
malapert_massif.dem: NASA ADC 2023 'Malapert Massif' height CSV (or LOLA)

haworth.label: Haworth
haworth.coords_source: Take the centre from the NASA ADC 2023 'Haworth' CSVs

medusae_fossae.label: Medusae Fossae Formation (yardangs)
medusae_fossae.coords_source: Location of THEMIS image PIA03770, NASA Photojournal (11° N, 159° W)
medusae_fossae.dem: MOLA MEGDR 128 px/deg for the 463 m scale; a CTX or HiRISE DTM for zoom-ins
medusae_fossae.profile_source: VERIFY: temperatures are rough placeholders, replace with Mars Climate Database values. dust_aod is a proxy: Mars is dustier than anywhere on Earth, so this asks for Earth's dustiest places.

arcadia_planitia.label: Arcadia Planitia (buried ice)
arcadia_planitia.coords_source: VERIFY in the USGS Gazetteer; approximate centre of the plains
arcadia_planitia.profile_source: VERIFY: temperatures are rough placeholders. Ground ice per NASA SWIM maps.

jezero.label: Jezero crater (ancient lake)
jezero.dem: MOLA MEGDR; HiRISE DTM of the delta for zoom-ins
